items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Betrag binnen 21 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum.
items.computation: The invoice date is 18.11.2026 (Wednesday). The period 'binnen 21 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum' is triggered by that calendar date, so per § 187(1) BGB the day itself is not counted and the period begins the next day, 19.11.2026. Counting 21 days from 19.11.2026 (§ 188(1) BGB): Nov 19-30 = 12 days, leaving 9 more days in December, landing on 09.12.2026. That date (Wednesday) is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW, so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed. Final due date: 09.12.2026.
